relevant_printable_strings.text: Compass sequence message does not have function name
Compass sequence message is missing arguments

decision_note: The decoded wad_r_ui.dcb goMapIcon rows are GOPool entries: its GOPool starts at 0x90, contains 255 fixed 16-byte rows, and ends exactly at 0x1080 where MemoryPools begins. A GOPool clone alone therefore cannot define new Raven artwork. This extraction targets the actual r_ui.wad prefab/material resources before any offline or runtime patch is built.
next_gate: Identify the concrete DockPoint map-icon prefab/material buffer and its texture references. Only then clone/retarget that resource for a Raven-only map visual; do not restore the global DockPoint texture override.
